summary.intent: Complete v1.1 milestone bookkeeping (backfill Phase 47 summaries, write Phase 48 verification), close a REQ-4 API gap by adding a share item-name backfill endpoint, ship via PR, write and run an e2e regression spec for the two-party UAT, resolve PR review comments, and debug a newly-discovered decrypt-after-move failure on staging.
summary.outcome: PR #505 merged to main (tagged as cipher-box-v0.41.0). All planned items shipped: Phase 47/48 planning artifacts written, PATCH /shares/:shareId/item-name endpoint added with full specs, web backfill wiring re-enabled, 7-test e2e spec passing locally and in CI (188/188). A CodeRabbit plaintext-buffer-zeroing fix was applied. Root cause of the decrypt-after-move bug was identified (FileMetadata re-encrypt missing from moveItem and restoreFromBin) and the moveItem fix was committed on a new branch, with restoreFromBin still pending.

repo: Phase 47 shipped via PR #494 but its 5 SUMMARY.md files were never written, causing a false-positive resume-incomplete gate (plans > summaries) that would have re-executed already-merged refactors.

The project enforces signed commits (commit.gpgsign=true via 1Password SSH op-ssh-sign); the sandboxed Bash environment cannot reach the signer, so commits made from sandboxed shells are silently unsigned.
Release-please bot pushes a chore(release) commit to feature branches immediately after gh pr create, requiring a fetch + rebase + re-sign before the final push.
web-e2e CI only runs on main-push (workflow_call) or manual dispatch — not on PRs — so the new spec gates post-merge, not during review.

The backfill trigger (backfillSentShareItemNames) fires exclusively via SDK getCoveringShares → reWrapNewItems → uploadFile; no 'sent shares list' UI page calls fetchAllSentShares, and ShareDialog bypasses it entirely.
FileMetadata IPNS records are AES-256-GCM encrypted with the parent folder's folderKey at upload time; moveItem and restoreFromBin must re-encrypt when reparenting a file.
restoreFromBin stores originalParentIpnsName on BinEntry but not the encrypting folderKey — the original parent folder may be gone at restore time, making the re-encrypt fix non-trivial.
CreateShareDto.itemNameEncrypted is @IsOptional (line 91); the service stores NULL when omitted, so legacy plaintext-only rows are API-creatable even though the web UI always sends ciphertext.
check-api-client.sh pre-commit hook requires the generated client to be committed alongside API endpoint changes; pnpm api:generate must be run before staging.

code.finding: backfillSentShareItemNames: plaintext itemName bytes from TextEncoder().encode() were not zeroed after ECIES wrapping — CodeRabbit finding; fixed with try/finally + Uint8Array.fill(0).

moveItem fix: after moving the FilePointer, unwrap the file's IPNS key, resolveFileMetadata with source.folderKey, then updateFileMetadata with dest.folderKey + createVersion:false — all inside withOperation before either folder publish so a failure aborts atomically.
getCoveringShares is called unconditionally on every item add (before the length check), guaranteeing the backfill fires on any uploadFile call.
restoreFromBin re-inserts the FilePointer and publishes folder metadata but never calls resolveFileMetadata/updateFileMetadata — same decrypt-after-reparent bug as the pre-fix moveItem.

itemNameEncrypted is @IsOptional — the service stores NULL when omitted, enabling legacy plaintext-only share rows to be seeded via direct API call (bypassing the web layer that always sends ciphertext).
createShare() in the web layer always sends itemNameEncrypted — the UI cannot produce a legacy NULL row; seeding one requires a page.evaluate(fetch) + /auth/refresh token pattern.

workflow: git rebase --force-rebase respects commit.gpgsign=true from config but does not always apply the signature; explicit -S flag on each commit or rebase exec is required to guarantee signing.

CodeRabbit posts some findings as 'outside diff range' comments embedded in the review body rather than resolvable inline threads — gh api graphql reviewThreads returns 0 for these; they must be scraped from the review body and replied to via REST comments.
Playwright runs `playwright test` unfiltered in CI (testDir: './tests', no testIgnore) — any new *.spec.ts added to the directory is automatically discovered without config changes.

The GSD resume-incomplete gate (plans > summaries) is a bookkeeping check, not a code-shipped check — a phase can be fully merged with zero summaries and still trip the gate, requiring manual override or summary backfill.

For a two-party e2e test needing a legacy DB row the UI cannot produce: use page.evaluate(fetch) + POST /auth/refresh token refresh pattern (from cleanup-helpers.ts) to POST directly to the API with the omitted field.
Polling fire-and-forget async operations in Playwright: GET the resource repeatedly until the field transitions (null → non-null) with a generous timeout (45s used here); don't rely on UI events.

friction: 1Password SSH signer wedged twice during the session — first producing silent failures (exit 0, no gpgsig header), then hanging with 'failed to fill whole buffer'; required a manual app restart each time.

Sandboxed Bash cannot reach op-ssh-sign: three commits were initially unsigned despite commit.gpgsign=true; detected only when inspecting raw commit objects, requiring an unsandboxed force-rebase with -S.
Release-please bot pushes chore(release) to branches immediately after PR creation, causing 'non-fast-forward' push failures; requires fetch + rebase + re-sign cycle.
Phase 47's false-positive resume gate would have routed to /gsd-execute-phase 47 and re-run already-merged refactors; required manual investigation of git history and VERIFICATION.md to detect.
Playwright HTML reporter in CI doesn't emit per-test names to stdout — impossible to grep for a specific spec's result in CI logs; pass/fail only verifiable by total count.
Network timeouts on gh API calls (workflow run list, review body fetch) required retries.
roadmap.analyze returned empty plan counts (bug in gsd-tools), forcing a fallback to direct ls-based phase scanning for the resume-incomplete check.
open_items: restoreFromBin in packages/sdk/src/bin/index.ts:317-393 has the same decrypt-after-reparent bug as the pre-fix moveItem — fix is on a branch but not yet implemented or PRed.

Design decision needed for the bin-restore re-encrypt: (a) resolve the original parent's folderKey via folderTree at restore time, or (b) capture the encrypting folderKey on BinEntry at deleteToBin time (robust but requires a metadata schema change).
/gsd-complete-milestone has not been run for v1.1 — STATE.md reads 100% but the milestone archive step is pending.
Literal raw-bytea Postgres read is not implemented in the web-e2e harness; the e2e spec uses GET /shares/sent hex != plaintext as a proxy assertion for ciphertext-at-rest.
web-e2e spec (share-itemname-backfill.spec.ts) only gates post-merge — there is no way to run it automatically on a PR with the current workflow_dispatch-only CI trigger.
Two-party live-environment UAT (legacy share display for recipient after owner backfill, plus ciphertext-at-rest DB read) remains a human check in a non-local environment.

The atomicity/ordering regression test for moveItem (assert re-encrypt runs before both folder publishes; thrown updateFileMetadata aborts the move) was flagged as an optional follow-up but not written.
